basic_info.description: Located in a classic 1920s building in the heart of Russian Hill, Unit #9 is warm and inviting. There is a full Golden Gate Bridge view in this bright 1BD/1BA TIC. The space offers approximately 559 square feet of thoughtfully preserved charm and modern amenities. Inside, the unit features hardwood floors, period molding, and a stunning original fireplace, adding timeless character to the light-filled living space. The kitchen is functional and well-equipped, and the in-unit washer/dryer provides everyday convenience.    Set within a secure, gated building with intercom entry and a peaceful garden walkway, residents also enjoy access to a shared rooftop deck with sweeping views of the city and Golden Gate Bridge ideal for relaxing or entertaining. With a stellar 97 Walk Score, you're just steps from Russian Hill's beloved cafes, shops, restaurants, cable cars, and MUNI bus routes. A Sirkin TIC agreement is in place, and HOA financials are professionally managed by Avenues HOA Financial Management.
